paper.title_en: Cubic Galileon Gravity on Nonlinear Scales with \texttt{Hi-COLA} for LSST Year 1
paper.abstract_en: Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) is in a prime position to test Modified Gravity (MG) with Weak Lensing (WL) and Large Scale Structure (LSS). However, many nonlinear MG emulators in the literature enforce a $Λ$CDM background by design, missing where data suggest the most interesting deviations lie. We present an emulator for the 3D nonlinear matter power spectrum in Cubic Galileon gravity, a Horndeski theory with a single additional MG parameter, $f_φ$, that modifies the background, growth, and lensing. Trained on \texttt{Hi-COLA} simulations with Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), the emulator achieves $\lesssim 2\%$ accuracy for $k \leq 1.2\ h\,\text{Mpc}^{-1}$ at the fiducial cosmology relative to \texttt{Hi-COLA}, and $\lesssim 5\%$ relative to full N-body \texttt{EFT-RAMSES} simulations. Additionally, conservative scale cuts excluding angular bins affected by baryonic physics enable unbiased parameter estimation in LSST Year 1 weak lensing and galaxy clustering ($3\times2$pt) forecasts, even when validated against simulated data based on higher-resolution N-body simulations. This demonstrates that, within a simplified LSST Y1 setup and the adopted scale cuts, \texttt{Hi-COLA}-based emulation is sufficient to develop inference infrastructure with Stage IV precision for Horndeski gravity models previously unmodeled on nonlinear scales.
authors: for the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文针对Cubic Galileon（Horndeski）引力的非线性物质功率谱构建基于Hi-COLA模拟与高斯过程回归的仿真器，并不强制ΛCDM背景，并用于LSST Y1弱透镜与星系成团的3×2pt参数估计验证，属于modified_gravity主题下具有明确方法学与预言价值的工作；论文尚新，零引用不作扣分。
decision.title_zh: 面向LSST第一年、基于\texttt{Hi-COLA}的非线性尺度Cubic Galileon引力研究
decision.abstract_zh: Vera C. Rubin天文台的时空遗产巡天（LSST）处于利用弱透镜（WL）和大尺度结构（LSS）检验修改引力（MG）的有利位置。然而，文献中许多非线性MG仿真器在设计上强制采用$\Lambda$CDM背景，因而错过了数据所提示的最有趣偏离可能出现之处。我们提出了Cubic Galileon引力中三维非线性物质功率谱的仿真器；Cubic Galileon是一种Horndeski理论，仅含一个额外的MG参数$f_\phi$，它修改背景、增长和透镜效应。该仿真器在\texttt{Hi-COLA}模拟上以高斯过程回归（GPR）训练，在基准宇宙学下相对于\texttt{Hi-COLA}，在$k \leq 1.2\ h\,\text{Mpc}^{-1}$范围内达到$\lesssim 2\%$的精度；相对于完整的N体\texttt{EFT-RAMSES}模拟达到$\lesssim 5\%$的精度。此外，保守的尺度截断（排除受重子物理影响的角度分箱）使得在LSST第一年弱透镜与星系成团（$3\times2$pt）预测量中能够进行无偏参数估计，即使在与基于更高分辨率N体模拟的模拟数据进行验证时也是如此。这表明，在简化的LSST Y1设置和所采用的尺度截断下，基于\texttt{Hi-COLA}的仿真足以针对此前未在非线性尺度上建模的Horndeski引力模型，发展具有Stage IV精度的推断基础设施。
